summary: Login returns 500 when password contains a plus sign
description: Users with '+' in their password get HTTP 500 on POST /api/auth/login. Expected: 401 for wrong password or 200 for valid credentials. Reproduce by URL-encoding the form body incorrectly in AuthController.

comments.author: qa@example.com
comments.body: Reproduced on staging. Stack trace points to AuthController.ValidatePassword.
